methodology.performance_rule: Public metrics are snapshots. Views grow over time, so article age and platform must be considered. We do not add metrics across platforms as if they were unique reach.
methodology.comparison_rule: Use same-platform comparisons wherever possible. A higher view count does not prove that a format or topic caused the result.
methodology.absence_rule: Not found means not found in the public audit, not proof that the company does not use the format internally.
methodology.telegram_note: Public Telegram metrics can be collected from public posts and analytics services where accessible; full historical TGStat data may require API access.
